title: Just right for between your knees
text: Just right for between your knees. I bought this pillow in my search to find the "perfect" between the knee at night pillow. I've tried several.... memory foam, buckwheat, regular size, body size, neck rolls, chair cushions, official "knee pillows" and haven't found one that worked for me. Until now.  This pillow is the perfect size and firmness for me.  It's small enough (but not too small) to keep between your legs and rolls with you as you move. It comes with a pillow case, a seriously good bonus.  Cases for this size of pillow is proving to bit of a challenge.  The pillow itself, along with the pillow case are bright white.  The case has faint lines as the photo shows. It is a foam type filling and is "soft" on the firmness level - perfect for my use.  It arrived quickly (I have prime)... however, when I opened the taped plastic bag, I found a dirty smudge on the pillow case. I had to decide if I should wash it or return it.  Ultimately I washed it and whatever it was came out.  Disappointing for seller to send out a "dirty" item.
